structural_play.purpose: High-volume structural, pacing, exposure and matchup screening; not a strong-play claim.

broad_card_screen.purpose: Paired real-card versus neutral-baseline screening under a fixed cheap policy.

strategic_confirmation.purpose: Targeted re-solving of suspicious paired card signals using the exact same contexts and interventions.

interpretation: Evidence is hierarchical. Heuristic self-play describes broad structure and exposure. Heuristic paired replacements are a screen for candidate card effects. A suspicious card is only treated as strategically confirmed when targeted online-MCCFR validation agrees. Censored games and paired samples remain structural evidence but are excluded from outcome estimates.
